issues.element: .band--hero .btn--ghost ("What's slipping? See how we'd fix it")
issues.problem: Inherits .btn{white-space:nowrap}; at 13px/.12em uppercase the link measures 354px. The band is 350px on a 390 phone and 320px on a 360 phone, so the arrow is clipped at 390 and the last 34px ("FIX IT ->") at 360 (probe: bandHero overflow 4px, .stage scrollWidth +52..59px, hidden only by html{overflow-x:clip}). Visible on sheet-a screen 1 as the arrow touching the edge.
issues.fix: @media (max-width:760px){ html[data-v="editorial"].story .band--hero .btn--ghost{white-space:normal;text-align:left;justify-content:flex-start;line-height:1.5;padding:6px 0;max-width:100%;background:none;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-decoration-color:var(--ghost-line);text-underline-offset:.3em} html[data-v="editorial"].story .band--hero .btn--ghost:hover{background:none;text-decoration-color:var(--ink)} }  (the editorial ghost draws its hairline as a background at 50%+13px, which cannot follow a second line, hence the switch to text-decoration). Scope: story + phone, so reduced-motion phones get the clipping fix too; flag to Karan.

issues.problem: The copy carries a no-break space ("something bigger"), so the last two words cannot wrap. At --hl-size = 10.8vw (42.1px at 390) the line is 424px in a 350px column: overflow 74px at 390, 72px at 360, 81px at 430; it renders as "SOMETHING BIGGE" (shot p360-climb). Copy is frozen (constraint 5), so the fix is typographic. The other nbsp pairs ("cooking them", "waiting for", "a reality") all fit.
issues.fix: @media (max-width:760px){ html[data-v="editorial"].story .band--climb .ln--2{font-size:.78em} }  -> 32.9px = 332px at 390, 30.3px = 306px at 360 (320 available). This is the deck's own "dimmer second line" treatment, one size smaller. For 320px-wide phones, where --hl-size sits on its 38px floor: @media (max-width:352px){ html[data-v="editorial"].story{--hl-size:clamp(32px,10.8vw,64px)} } -> 27px = 272px in a 280px column. Neither rule can reach html.film (10.8vw clamps to 64px on any desktop anyway).

issues.problem: The still is a 16:9 strip, 390x219 (26svh) with 25px act padding. The words are centred in the strip with padding-bottom 22%, which lands them 33-49px below the strip's top: exactly over the small upper cloud (white type on white cloud, held only by the text-shadow), while the big cloud fills the bottom 45%. Beat A: "FEEL THE GROWTH." (33.15px) crosses the small cloud. Beat B: two lines 33.15px + 19.9px (67px block) fill the 80px black band between the clouds and the first line sits on the small cloud (shot p360-sky-b). The strip is also too short to be a beat: it reads as a banner between two headlines, and the fixed contact bar parks on the white cloud when the strip is low on screen.
issues.fix: See skyPlan: a 4/5 figure with the frame's lower 74% shown (the small cloud pushed out of the top), the words placed in the black band above the big cloud, a radial scrim under the caption, and the accent words kept. Scoped @media (max-width:760px) html[data-v="editorial"].story (legibility defect, so reduced-motion phones get it too).

issues.problem: Once the film sits behind the hero on the phone, the still is the same cloche shown twice. Today it is a masked 16:10 strip (390x244) starting at y=553 with the cloche cropped at the left edge (object-position 66%), read as a video that will not play (sheet-a screen 1, shot p360-still).
issues.fix: See stillPlan: hidden under html.story.pfilm, kept as the plain-story fallback, and its JPEG reused as the phone film's poster crop and the first paint of the blur layer, so no new poster asset is needed.

issues.problem: Two 350x197 (16:9) thumbnails, 50px apart (2 x 25px act padding), tabs floating in the gap: the AFTER tab is 27px tall in a 25px padding and overlaps the plate above by 2px; the pair reads as two small pictures, not one room before and after (sheet-a screen 6).

issues.problem: Each beat carries a 64px tick + 26px margin + 67.5px band padding = 158px (19svh) of air above its headline and 67.5px below; about 1000px of the 5834px stage is tick air. On pfilm the ticks would also fight the snake: a 1px tick at x=20 beside a 3px rainbow line at x=10.
issues.fix: html[data-v="editorial"].story.pfilm .band:not(.band--hero) .band__in::before{display:none} html[data-v="editorial"].story.pfilm .band{padding:clamp(40px,7vh,64px) 0}. The snake is the line climbing; the plain story (reduced motion, no WebCodecs) keeps its ticks untouched.

issues.problem: Mixed alignment: the headline "LET'S TURN YOUR DREAM INTO A REALITY." is left-set on three 42px lines with a left tick, then the mark (218x120) is centred, the wordmark (31.2px, 280px) centred, the rule full width (350px); 50px of dead act padding between the mark and the wordmark. A line arriving from the left has no clear entry point and no lockup to land in (shot p360-resolve).
issues.fix: See resolvePlan: centred lockup that fits one screen (351px tall), mark at min(62vw,280px), the snake entering the left lobe, the loop drawn over the mark's box, the image fading in behind it, then the wordmark rule drawing from the left.

issues.problem: No defect. Cards are 350px wide, 373-490px tall, 50px apart, .pan__ttl 30px, .pan__line 16px, mocks at 10px (aria-hidden). The only phone-specific hazard is the new left gutter line: the snake runs at x=10 and the card border is at x=20, so they clear each other only while the cards stay in the column.
issues.fix: Keep. Do not bleed the cards. Optional tightening under pfilm: html[data-v="editorial"].story.pfilm .pan.act{padding:clamp(10px,2.4vh,22px) 0} so the four cards run as one column (40px apart) beside the line.

issues.problem: Two "GET YOUR PLAN ->" on the first screen: the 12px text link top-right and the full-width orange button. The header's link only hides once the contact bar is on (past 85svh).
issues.fix: Optional: @media (max-width:760px){ html[data-v="editorial"].story:not(.past-hero) .nav__cta{opacity:0;visibility:hidden} } (site.js already toggles html.past-hero at y > .85vh), so one call to action shows at a time.

heroSpec.layout:
MODE HOOK. site.js adds html.pfilm only when: html.story && matchMedia('(max-width:720px) and (orientation:portrait)').matches && !prefers-reduced-motion && (window.VideoDecoder || heroVideo.canPlayType('video/mp4;codecs="avc1.640028"')). Removed on decode failure (the plain story with the still returns by itself) and re-evaluated in applyMode(); html.film never has it, so nothing here can touch the desktop.

DOM. While pfilm is on, site.js moves #hero to be the first child of .band--hero (and back before #sky when pfilm goes off, before enableFilm can run). The hero is then position:sticky;top:0;height:100svh with margin-bottom:-100svh, .band--hero gets min-height:var(--pf-run,350svh) and its .band__in sits over it at z-index 1. Sticky inside the band means the film is viewport-locked for exactly (350 - 100) = 250svh of scroll and is released, jitter-free, at s = 250svh; the hero's page top then stays at 250svh forever, which is what lets the page-space line continue seamlessly from the viewport-space birth segment. .stage loses its 102px padding-top on pfilm; the band supplies it (calc(var(--hdr-h) + 10svh)).

THE FILM BOX (390x844 numbers; svh throughout so the URL bar never jumps it). A phone encode of the same film, cropped to the frame's right 54% (x 46-100%, the measured bright bounds of cloche, lid and mark are x 47-99%, y 31-84%), 1037x1080 scaled to 720x750, frames 0-231 (0-7.7s: the mark is whole through 7.9s, the unravel starts at 8.0s), same x264 recipe (keyint 8, no B-frames, bt709), crf 21, about 1.1MB, plus hero-phone-data.json with t0:0. .hero__frame is width:100vw; height:calc(100vw*750/720) = 390x406, top:12svh (101px), so the cloche centre (57% of the box) sits at 332px = 39svh and the revealed mark (53%) at 316px = 37svh. It carries a vertical mask (transparent 0-10% and 90-100%) so the box dissolves into the page's dotted ground; the hero background is transparent. During the blurred phase the box is scaled 1.2 about its centre (468x487, y 60-548) so the glow fills the area behind the words.

LAYERS inside the box, bottom to top: the poster (background-image hero-still.jpg at 185% auto, position 100% 50% = the identical crop, visible before decode); #heroFilm, the existing WebGL canvas at the encode's 720x750, opacity 1 always; #heroSoft, a 32x33 2D canvas created by site.js on arm, painted from the same decoded VideoFrame with one drawImage and CSS-stretched to 108% of the box: the 12x bilinear upscale IS the blur (no filter of any kind; add a plain CSS filter:blur(6px) only if a device test shows bilinear diamonds), opacity var(--pf-soft); then the scrim, .hero::after, a vertical gradient (see legibility) with opacity calc(.28 + .72*var(--pf-scrim)); then the birth SVG (#heroSnake, 100vw x 100svh, viewport space). Above the hero: .band__in with h1, sub, cta.

TEXT RHYTHM (390x844): header 0-52; band padding-top 52+84 = 136; h1 136-279 (--hero-size 11.3vw = 44.07px, line 1 "WE'LL POST THE SPECIALS." two visual lines at 44px with SPECIALS. in acc 800 italic, line 2 "YOU KEEP COOKING THEM." two lines at .7em = 30.8px in ink-3); sub 305-358 (17px, 2 lines, indent 56px); primary button 388-440 (52px, full width, acc on ink); ghost link 450-494 (wrapped per issue 1). Text block bottom at 59svh; the lower 41svh shows the blurred cloche's glow and the dark ground, which is the scroll cue.

PHASES (s = scrollY in svh; all vars set on #hero from one passive scroll listener coalesced into one rAF): 0-30 hold: film t=0, soft 1, scrim 1, zoom 1.2. 30-45: film 0-0.6s (first wisps of steam), still blurred. 45-110 sharpen: soft 1-0, scrim 1-0 (leaving the .28 edge vignette), zoom 1.2-1, film 0.6-1.6s; the text has left the top by s=60. 110-195 reveal: film 1.6-5.8s (lid lifts 2.7-4.2, mark alone by 5.8; 126 frames over 717px = 5.7px per frame). 195-222 hold + birth: film 5.8-7.0s; the birth path in #heroSnake draws from the mark's centre out of the left lobe to (10, 37svh) at the screen's left edge, a shallow S ("like a snake"), between s=200 and 225. 222-245 the canvas fades (--pf-film 1-0, class off at 245); the birth path stays because it is SVG, not canvas. 250 release: the hero scrolls with the page; the page-space snake starts at (10, 250svh + 37svh) with zero length and its head is pinned at viewport 37svh (page y = s + 37svh), so it grows exactly as you scroll. The studio beat ("MEET.") enters the viewport bottom at s=250, right as the film has gone, so the screen is never empty.

FIXED CHROME. .hdr fixed, 52px, z 90: brand mark 28x17 + DOMIN8TE at x=20, the ground gradient (#0A0A0A to transparent over 28px) once scrolled; the film box starts at 101px so the lifted lid (which reaches the crop's top at 4.2s) never runs under the header. .ctabar fixed, z 80, x 20-370, y 778-830 (bottom 14px + safe area), shown by site.js at s > 85svh (during the sharpen phase, once the hero's own button is off screen) and never over the film box (box bottom 60svh). The snake runs at x=10, the centre of the 20px gutter; band text starts at x=20; full-bleed props (sky stills, the pair) are crossed by the line on purpose.
heroSpec.legibility:
Tokens: ink #EDEAE4, ink-2 #8F8C86 (sub), ink-3 #86837D (h1 line 2), acc #FF5B1F (SPECIALS., button), ground #0A0A0A. On the plain ground: ink 16.5:1, ink-2 5.9:1, ink-3 5.2:1, acc 6.4:1; button ink on acc 6.4:1 (unaffected by the film).

Simulated on the real frames f-0, f-1.2 and f-2.7 (the frames that play behind the text), cropped to the phone box at 390px and blurred: the worst pixel behind the words is the blurred cloche highlight and the bokeh lights that sit behind the h1. Without a scrim the blurred backdrop peaks at about #907456 (ink 3.6:1, sub 1.3:1): not acceptable. With the scrim at .84 over a >=16px-equivalent blur the worst backdrop is #1F1A16: ink 14.4:1, ink-2 5.1:1, ink-3 4.6:1, acc 5.6:1. At .90 it is #171411: ink 15.3:1, ink-2 5.5:1, acc 5.9:1. With a weaker 10px blur the .84 scrim still gives ink 13.2:1, ink-2 4.7:1, acc 5.1:1. So: scrim gradient rgba(10,10,10,.92) at 0, .90 to 60svh (behind h1, sub, both buttons), easing to .60 at 74svh and .34 at 100svh (the cloche glows through below the text). Every word clears WCAG AA (4.5:1) with the 200-weight display type well past the 3:1 large-text bar; the thinnest strokes (h1 line 2 in ink-3 at 30.8px, weight 200) hold at 4.6:1 minimum. Once the text has scrolled off, --pf-scrim goes to 0 and only the .28 vignette remains so the sharp film still sits in the dark ground. The soft canvas is a 32px upscale, equivalent to a 12-16px blur at 390px; no SVG filter anywhere on the phone.

stillPlan: Hide it under pfilm: html[data-v="editorial"].story.pfilm .act--still{display:none} (the --o:2 slot simply closes; the studio band follows the 350svh hero band). Keep the element and its trick exactly as they are for the plain story: reduced motion, no WebCodecs and no seekable
skyPlan:
Measured: at 390 the figure is 390x219; the frame's small cloud spans y 4-33% (9-72px) and x 40-95% (still A) or 8-55% (still B); the big cloud fills the bottom 45-52%; the black band between them is about 80px. The caption block is 36px (beat A) or 67px (beat B: "TAKING YOUR TIME?" 33.15px + "THEY'RE TAKING YOUR CUSTOMERS." 19.9px, which fits on one line down to 320px wide), centred with padding-bottom 22%, so it lands on the small cloud.

Fix, scoped @media (max-width:760px){ html[data-v="editorial"].story ... } (a legibility defect, so the reduced-motion phone gets it too; the desktop's .sky layer and html.film .act--sky clipping are untouched):
.skystill{aspect-ratio:4/5;overflow:hidden}   /* 390x488 = 58svh: a beat, not a banner */
.skystill__img{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:0;width:auto;height:135%;max-width:none;transform:translateX(-50%);aspect-ratio:auto}   /* the frame's lower 74% shown, magnified 1.35 (527 CSS px of a 1600px source, still sharp at 2x): the small cloud's belly ends 46px from the top, the big cloud's ridge starts at 300px, leaving a 50-290px black slot */
.skystill__words{align-items:center;padding:0 6% 58%}   /* centre of the free height = 21% of the figure = 102px, inside the slot; beat B's 67px block spans 70-135px */
.skystill__words::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:62%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 72% 60% at 50% 45%,rgba(10,10,10,.72) 0%,rgba(10,10,10,0) 70%);pointer-events:none}   /* a soft local scrim under the caption, gradient not filter */
.skystill__words .hl--sky{position:relative}   /* above the scrim */
Keep .hl--sky at clamp(28px,8.5vw,46px), the .6em second line, the accent words (growth / taking / customers) in --acc and the existing text-shadow. Optional per-beat framing: .act--sky:first-of-type .skystill__img{left:44%} (still A's small cloud sits right, so shift it further out) and the second beat left:56%. On pfilm the act keeps its full-bleed margins and the snake crosses the still's left edge: the line rising over the clouds, the desktop's own image. The fixed contact bar will still park over the big cloud when the figure is low on screen; that is the bar's job and not a layout fault.
resolvePlan:
Layout under html[data-v="editorial"].story.pfilm (reduced motion keeps today's resolve exactly): .band--resolve .band__in{text-align:center} (the film already centres band--c); .band--resolve{padding-bottom:28px}; .act--mark{padding:8px 0 0}; .storymark{width:min(62vw,280px)} -> 242x133 at 390, centred, left edge x=74; .act--word{padding:14px 0 48px}; .wordmark stays clamp(30px,8vw,46px) = 31.2px, 280px wide; .act--word .rule{transform:scaleX(0)} and .act--word.is-drawn .rule{transform:scaleX(1);transition:transform .9s var(--ease-out)} (transform-origin left is already set); .act--mark .storymark{opacity:0;transition:opacity .5s var(--ease)} and .act--mark.is-merged .storymark{opacity:1}. The lockup (headline 3 lines 119px + 28 + 8 + mark 133 + 14 + wordmark 31 + 16 + rule 2 = 351px) fits one 844 screen above the contact bar, so the merge is seen whole.

Geometry (site.js measures .storymark's rect after layout and on resize; all in page px inside the .snake SVG, viewBox = 0 0 stageW stageH): mark centre (cx, cy); k = markW / 215 (the desktop's own ratio: #loop is 200 units wide at scale 2.7 = 540 world units under a 580-unit mark, i.e. 0.93 of the mark) = 1.125 at 390; the loop path is the #loop d re-ordered to start at its left extreme, "M8 60C8 36 26 16 52 16C78 16 100 32 100 60C100 88 122 104 148 104C174 104 192 84 192 60C192 36 174 16 148 16C122 16 100 32 100 60C100 88 78 104 52 104C26 104 8 84 8 60Z", placed with transform="translate(cx - 100k, cy - 60k) scale(k)", stroke url(#infg) (already in the page's defs), stroke-width 5.5px/k, round caps, no filter. Entry point E = the loop's first point (cx - 92k, cy) = (84, cy) at 390. The snake's last segment leaves the gutter at (10, cy - 26svh) and arrives horizontally: C 10 (cy - 10svh), 40 cy, 84 cy.

Sequence, a pure function of scrollY so it scrubs both ways like the desktop: the snake head is pinned at viewport 37svh, so it reaches E when s0 = cy - 37svh (the wordmark is then at about 50svh, the contact bar at 92svh: no overlap). Over s0..s0+24svh the loop draws (stroke-dashoffset from its length to 0, one full circuit from the left lobe); from 70% of the circuit .act--mark gets is-merged and the real mark fades in behind the drawing while the loop's strokes fade to 0 over the last 30%; at 100% .act--word gets is-drawn and the rule draws from the left, the same gesture the text makes on the desktop. The tip glow (.snake__tip, a radial-gradient div positioned by transform) dies with the loop's last 30%. Snake colour: a new userSpaceOnUse linearGradient in the snake SVG, y1 = birth y, y2 = birth y + 1600px, spreadMethod repeat, the eight --spec stops, so the rainbow cycles down the page and arrives at the mark; the loop itself uses #infg so it matches the mark's ribbon.
